Feel free to open an issue on GitHub in any language."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Problem & Purpose"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"When streaming responses from DeepSeek models via third-party proxies, gateways, or incompatible pro"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"viders, protocol closing tags for tool invocations (DSML — DeepSeek Markup Language) occasionally le"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ak into the visible text channel. Users observe raw markup at the end of their conversation:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Additionally, reasoning models (such as DeepSeek-R1 / V3) or interrupted network streams can leave o"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"rphan `</think>` tags, dangling tokens (`<｜end of sentence｜>`), or unclosed thinking blocks that cor"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"rupt markdown rendering."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-dsml-artifact-guard`** is a high-performance runtime guard for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" that cleans these protocol artifacts in real time before they reach the user interface:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. **Strict Synchronous Hook Contract**: Implements the Cordis `llm/stream` hook synchronously, retu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rning an `AsyncIterable` directly to preserve runtime integrity and avoid fatal `TypeError: stream i"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"s not async iterable` errors.
2. **Chunk Boundary Buffer**: Uses a 96-byte sliding window to reliabl"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"y intercept closing tags fragmented across network packet boundaries.
3. **Incomplete Token Recovery"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" at Finish**: Detects and strips truncated protocol closing prefixes (`</｜DSML｜...`) when connection"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s terminate abruptly.
4. **Reasoning Artifact Protection (`cleanThinkArtifacts`)**: Strips orphan `<"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"/think>` tags, removes trailing reasoning markers, and heals unclosed `<think>` blocks at stream fin"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ish.
5. **Fail-Open Tag Balancing**: Tracks open and closed tags to guarantee that legitimate techni"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"cal discussions containing DSML or think examples are never altered.
6. **Live Telemetry & Metrics D"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ashboard**: Real-time in-memory counters (guarded sessions, stripped tags, last incident time, and r"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ecent events log) available directly in the native Web UI card."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 📦 Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install into your DeepSeek Harness web profile:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart your DeepSeek Harness instance."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration (`settings.yaml`)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Configure matching rules in `settings.yaml` or through the Web UI Settings Card:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Configuration Parameters"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
